suppress.notes: HdrHistogram 2.1.12 is pulled in by java-driver-core 4.17.0. CVE-2026-14683 and CVE-2026-14686 report affected versions through 2.2.2: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-14683 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-14686 Maven Central's latest stable release is 2.2.2, which is also affected; no published minor/patch upgrade in major 2 fixes these findings. https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/hdrhistogram/HdrHistogram/maven-metadata.xml Upstream disputes these reports and closed the corresponding issues: https://github.com/HdrHistogram/HdrHistogram/issues/219 https://github.com/HdrHistogram/HdrHistogram/issues/222 Accepted, not fixed: decoding untrusted compressed histogram data can exhaust memory; recording untrusted NaN values can corrupt statistics. The advisories describe local-access prerequisites and disputed security boundaries. Reassess when a fixed stable major-2 release is published.

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.
